description: Create a CoinVoyage PayOrder (merchant invoice). Use type="DEPOSIT" for normal merchant-initiated invoices (public key is sufficient). Use "SALE" for point-of-sale flows or "REFUND" for refunds — both require an API secret.

amount.description: Invoice amount. Use a fiat currency (e.g. USD) or a token symbol.

expiresInSeconds.description: Optional: how long the PayOrder stays payable before expiring.

metadata.description: Arbitrary merchant metadata (orderId, sku, customer, etc.).

settlement.description: Where funds settle. Example: { chainId: 8453, token: "USDC" } to receive USDC on Base.

name: create_pay_order
